# lax_mode_violation_recorded

Pins ``lax=True`` semantics: when the cowalk hits a structural
invariant violation the planner MUST record the violation in
``OutputState.violations`` (surfaced as ``result["violations"]`` via
the ``StreamPlanner.violations`` property) AND continue, producing a
best-effort planner result — not raise. Today's
``dependency_graph_worker`` default is ``lax=True``; this fixture
pins those semantics so a future refactor that flips back to
abort-on-violation gets caught.

**Bug pinned**: the original streaming-planner implementation only
had a strict mode that raised ``TreeWalkError`` on the first
invariant violation. Survey mode (``lax=True``, added in Phase 3.2)
swaps every ``raise`` to a ``planner._record(kind, **details)`` call
on the same code paths, lets the planner finish, and exposes the
list under ``violations`` for downstream diagnostics. The test
must:

  1. confirm ``plan_from_tree_streaming(tree_text, archs=..., lax=True)``
     completes without raising,
  2. confirm ``result["violations"]`` has at least one entry with
     ``kind == "calibration-same-name-count-mismatch"``,
  3. confirm the planner still emits ``build_variant`` descriptors
     for both variants (best-effort recovery).

**Exact invariant violated**: ``calibration-same-name-count-mismatch``
— see ``template_graph/cowalk/build_template.py:160-174``
(``_walk_common_pair_children``). When the calibration pair's two raw
trees both have children that role-collapse onto the same name but in
DIFFERENT cardinalities, strict raises ``TreeWalkError("calibration
pair same-name child count mismatch")``; lax records the kind above
with ``node_role``, ``child_name``, ``t0_count``, ``t1_count`` and
walks the shorter prefix. Cascading violations
(``cowalk-child-count-mismatch`` at re-classification time, plus
``unclassified-at-matrix-end`` for the orphaned third
``lib-thing-3.0.drv`` actual) are recorded too — total violation
count for this fixture is exactly 3, so the harness MAY assert
``len(result["violations"]) >= 1`` and ``"calibration-same-name-count-mismatch"
in {v["kind"] for v in result["violations"]}``.

**Tree**: 1 binary ``hello`` × 1 cell (x86_64, gcc15) × 2 variants
(O0, O1). Variant 0 has TWO children named
``lib-thing-{1,2}.0.drv``; variant 1 has THREE children named
``lib-thing-{1,2,3}.0.drv``. The ``drv_role`` extractor strips
versions, so both sides collapse to a single common-name bucket
``lib-thing.drv`` with mismatched cardinality (2 vs 3).

**Expected**:
  - ``build_variant_count == 2`` — best-effort recovery still emits
    both variants.
  - ``violations_min: 1`` — at least one violation entry. This is a
    NEW optional field in the expected.json schema; the harness
    reads it as ``int >= 1`` (the actual count in this fixture is
    3, but pinning a lower-bound keeps the assertion robust against
    invariant churn).
  - ``violations_at_least_kinds: ["calibration-same-name-count-mismatch"]``
    — every kind name in this list MUST appear in
    ``{v["kind"] for v in result["violations"]}``. Also a new field;
    documents which specific invariant the fixture exercises so the
    test pins THE pinned violation rather than "any violation at all".
  - ``relax_dependent_count: true`` — opt-out of the harness's >= 2
    dependents-per-non-toolchain-dep rule. The lax cowalk records
    violations and walks a SHORTER prefix on the mismatched side, so
    common_deps emitted from the truncated walk may legitimately have
    fewer dependents than the architectural rule normally requires.
    This is the ONLY fixture allowed the exemption; all others must
    expand their variant set rather than relax.

The harness MUST run the planner with ``lax=True`` and assert the
result is non-None (no exception). With ``lax=False`` (the strict
mode), the planner raises ``TreeWalkError("calibration pair
same-name child count mismatch ...")`` — this fixture is NOT
expected to round-trip cleanly through strict mode, and the harness
should skip the strict-mode comparison for this fixture if it has
one.

**variant_lookup.json convention**: list-of-records,
``[{"key": [arch, label], "value": {...}}, ...]``.

**tree.txt provenance**: generated by
``template_graph.tests.test_streaming.fixtures.render_tree`` (seeds
0/1/2 for root/toolchain/matrix, 10/20 for variant roots, 110-122
for the per-variant ``lib-thing-{N}.0.drv`` children). Pattern
borrowed verbatim from
``template_graph.tests.test_streaming.test_modes.test_lax_mode_records_violations_not_raises``.
